summary: First full test pass of MYVOLT (Route39 fleet/rental ops). Backend: 42 pytest cases across auth, dashboard, reports, search, fleet CRUD+transfer, drivers+assignment, rental full lifecycle (create->payments->activate->renew->suspend->close with ledger math), rental plans, service requests workflow (new->assigned->inspection->repair->ready + closure via service record), vehicle services, documents/incidents/locations/handovers/returns, permissions (staff 403, service_manager scoping) and Chennai city-manager scoping — 39 passed / 3 failed. Frontend: UI login (admin/ops/city_manager/staff), dashboard KPIs (280/214/35/17/14), donut, 4 city cards, needs-attention, recent ops, all 12 nav routes render with zero console/page errors, vehicle profile with 7 tabs, 7-step Create Rental wizard completed end-to-end (rental RNT-1216 created, payment recorded, activated, ledger correct), SR kanban (21 cards across 6 stages), reports charts, locations, incidents, global search, fleet/rental filter chips, Add Vehicle modal (ops) saving successfully, staff correctly does not see Add Vehicle. No trip/passenger/fare features present (as required).

minor.issue: No brute-force protection/lockout: 7 consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401 with no 423/429 throttle or attempt counter (playbook requires lockout after 5 fails).

Inconsistent semantics: dashboard rentals.payment_pending = 77 (counts payment_status pending/partial) but the Needs-Attention deep link /rentals?status=pending_payment returns 0 items (list filter matches rental.status=='pending_payment' only). Users clicking '77 pending rental payment(s)' land on an empty list. Also 77 vs 80 rentals actually unpaid because suspended rentals are `continue`d before the payment check.

No 404 guard: rental doc is fetched then used unconditionally (r['driver_id']); a bogus/other-org id raises TypeError -> 500 instead of 404. Same pattern: suspend/close skip the `if not r` check that activate/renew have.

minor.endpoint: PUT /api/vehicles/{vid}, PUT /api/drivers/{did}, PUT /api/service-requests/{sid}, POST /api/documents, POST /api/incidents, POST /api/handovers
minor.issue: Accept raw `dict` bodies with no Pydantic validation (arbitrary fields can be written into Mongo docs); also PUT endpoints return 200 even when the id matches no document (silent no-op update).

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True. It works today only because frontend and API share one origin; with a separate origin browsers reject credentialed responses that carry ACAO '*'. Playbook expects explicit origins.
_next_rental_code / SR / INC codes are derived from count_documents, so concurrent creates or deletions can produce duplicate codes (no unique index on rental_code/code).

ui_bugs.issue: Fleet list requests page_size=120 with no pagination / load-more / infinite scroll while the org has 281 vehicles — 160+ vehicles are unreachable by browsing (only via search or status filter). Backend already returns total/page.

Staff sees all 12 nav items (Reports, Settings, Documents, Vehicle Service, Service Requests) although auth.ROLE_ACCESS limits staff to fleet/drivers/rentals/dashboard; pages load fully with no gating message. Nav should be filtered by role (write actions are correctly hidden/403).
'77 pending rental payment(s)' navigates to /rentals?status=pending_payment which renders an empty list (see backend inconsistency).
City manager (chennai@route39.in) still sees all 4 cities in the city selector and header reads 'All Cities' although data is hard-scoped to Chennai; selecting another city yields empty views.

integration_issues.issue: Chennai city manager sees audit entries such as 'Vehicle moved to Bangalore' (audit rows keep city=to_city/from_city), leaking other-city activity into a city-scoped view.

issues: Seeded vehicle image (seed.py VEHICLE_IMG pexels 32910572) is an unrelated stock photo of a barbershop storefront ('VICX CUTS AND SHAVES') used as the hero banner for every EV — replace with an EV/fleet image.
Uses two native <input type="date"> browser pickers instead of the shadcn calendar/date-picker used elsewhere in the design system.
'Fleet' section card holds a single KPI (Total Fleet) leaving ~80% empty width; bar chart x-axis labels truncated to 'Tir/Coi/Che/Ban'.
Most SR cards show '—' for driver name (seed does not populate driver_name), making cards look broken.

action_items: Add pagination (or load-more/infinite scroll) to Fleet page — currently only 120 of 281 vehicles are browsable.

Align 'payment pending' semantics: either make /api/rentals?status=pending_payment match payment_status pending/partial, or change the dashboard KPI + deep link (e.g. status=payment_pending) so the Needs-Attention link is not empty.
Add `if not r: raise HTTPException(404)` to /api/rentals/{rid}/suspend and /close (currently 500 on bad id).
Add brute-force lockout/throttling on POST /api/auth/login (5 failed attempts -> 423/429) per auth playbook.
Filter sidebar nav by auth.ROLE_ACCESS so staff/service_manager do not see modules they are not meant to use.
Replace seed VEHICLE_IMG with a relevant EV/fleet image; populate driver_name on seeded service requests.
Set explicit CORS_ORIGINS instead of '*' since allow_credentials=True.
Replace native date inputs in the rental wizard with the shadcn date picker; scope city selector to the city_manager's city.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1115 lines with all routers in one file — split into routers/ modules (auth, fleet, drivers, rentals, service, misc) per the <700 line guideline.
suspend_rental/close_rental dereference `r` without a None check — guaranteed 500 for invalid/cross-city ids.

Many mutating endpoints take untyped `dict` bodies (vehicles PUT, drivers PUT, SR PUT, documents/incidents/handovers/returns POST) — add Pydantic models; today any arbitrary key is persisted, and PUTs cannot report 404.
Sequential-code generation via count_documents (RNT-/SR-/INC-) is race-prone; use a counters collection with findAndModify plus a unique index.
Dashboard rental aggregation loads all rentals into Python (find(base).to_list(5000)) — use aggregation pipelines before the dataset grows.

org_filter enforces city for city_manager on collections that have a `city` field, but audit_logs/notifications rely on the stored city value, which for transfers is the destination city — city-scoped users can see other cities' activity text.

success_rate.backend: 93% (39/42 pytest cases; the 3 failures are the brute-force lockout gap and 2 data-consistency assertions)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all 12 routes + wizard + CRUD flows work; issues are pagination, role-based nav gating and cosmetic)

seed_data_creation: Test artifacts left in DB (prefixed TEST_/TEST-/UI-TEST): vehicles TEST-V1, TEST-V2, UI-TEST-1; drivers 'TEST_Driver A', 'TEST_Rental Driver'; plan 'TEST_Plan Weekly'; location 'TEST_Hub X'; document 'TEST_Insurance'; incident INC-3010 'TEST_Minor scratch'; service request SR-2021 'TEST_Brake noise'; rentals RNT-121x created via API/UI wizard. Main agent may purge docs matching /^TEST[_-]|^UI-TEST/.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md present and all 5 accounts (admin/ops/city_manager/service_manager/staff, password Route39@2026) log in successfully; bcrypt hashes verified to start with $2b$; httpOnly access_token cookie set on login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite lives in /app/backend/tests (conftest.py provides admin/ops/city_mgr/svc_mgr/staff fixtures using Bearer tokens; run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v`). backend_test.py covers all modules and passes fully. test_consistency.py intentionally fails on the payment_pending KPI mismatch and Fleet pagination gap — re-run after fixes. test_seed_hash.py hits Mongo directly for bcrypt/org checks. Frontend flows already verified: login, all 12 nav routes, vehicle profile tabs, 7-step rental wizard end-to-end, Add Vehicle modal, fleet/rental filter chips, city-manager Chennai scoping, staff role hiding write buttons. Not yet tested: Handover/Return/Transfer modals from the vehicle profile, Documents upload (base64) UI, Incidents create modal, VehicleService create modal, Settings user creation, mobile viewport (390x844) layout.
rca_of_the_issue: payment_pending mismatch: dashboard_summary counts rentals whose payment_status is pending/partial, while list_rentals' status filter compares against rental.status/display_status where 'pending_payment' only exists before activation — so the deep link returns nothing. Fleet gap: Fleet.jsx line 30 hardcodes {page_size: 120} and never reads the `total`/`page` fields returned by /api/vehicles, so vehicles beyond the first 120 are unreachable. suspend/close 500 risk: those handlers omit the `if not r` guard present in activate/renew.
